scope: Returned sitemap URLs matching /investments/options/exchange-traded-funds/products/; not asserted to be a complete ETF universe.
limitations: Only URL-derived ticker/name are recorded. ISIN, index, provider, index type, weighting, cadence, inception date, and active/closed status are not inferred.
Closed entries are segregated and not included in records.
The sitemap is an official enumerator response, but this artifact makes no completeness claim beyond the returned rows.
